note: Tour bubbles. Anchors are data-testid values and must exist in the built UI (test H6). expected_screen feeds the off_script capture event.

steps.text: This case was presented to Lender A as a frozen snapshot. Everything on it can be traced to its source.
Each requirement shows its evidence, who verified it, and its limitation. The lender decides what to accept.
Switch to Lender B. Same enterprise, same project, different requirements and a different result.
Raise a dispute on the income records and watch the requirement turn into an exception.
Readiness is recomputed from the evidence. It was not edited by anyone.
A different field agent re-verifies the evidence. Uploading a new record would not have closed the dispute.
Assign verification of the same evidence to the lender's own verifier.
The verifier sees their queue, opens the assignment and records a finding. A finding never changes the evidence.
The lender records its own reliance decision. It is not an approval.
The lender chooses an outcome. Nothing is pre-selected and Symphony never decides.
After financing, the same evidence is the baseline for monitoring. This covenant is overdue.
Every number here is computed and can be followed down to its evidence.
Export the readiness record. It is not mapped to any institution's system.
Cooperatives move through stages. Every count is computed from the same engine the lenders see.
Click a stage to list the cooperatives in it.
Baseline against current for a cohort. Gaps closed shows progress since the demo was loaded.
Open requirements are grouped by the kind of support they need.
A stale registration is blocked. It needs a renewal that happens outside the platform.
Close a governance gap: minutes, sign-off, then independent verification.
Switch destination to see the same state against different requirements.
The baseline captured at readiness is the starting point for any later monitoring.
Presenting freezes a snapshot for the lender, who then assesses independently.
Switch to a technical assistance user. They see only their own cohort.
